scenarios.threat_scenario: Hostile webpage embeds system prompt overrides, fake tool invocations, and script tags attempting to trick downstream LLM into granting unauthorized capabilities.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Extracted page text is strictly fenced in <untrusted>...</untrusted> with warning preamble.
scenarios.actual_result: Page text strictly enclosed in <untrusted> block with UNTRUSTED_PREAMBLE; no instruction execution.

scenarios.threat_scenario: Adversary attempts to replay a consumed one-use capability, replay on a different step, present a forged capability ID, or tamper with action parameters.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Exact binding denies replay with ALREADY_CONSUMED, forged token with UNKNOWN, step mismatch with STEP_MISMATCH, and parameter tamper with PARAMETERS_MISMATCH.
scenarios.actual_result: All replay, forged, step-mismatched, and parameter-tampered capabilities rejected fail-closed.

scenarios.threat_scenario: Tenant B attempts to consume Tenant A's capability, or Errand 2 uses Errand 1's capability.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Cross-tenant attempt yields TENANT_MISMATCH (or UNKNOWN); cross-errand yields ERRAND_MISMATCH.
scenarios.actual_result: Cross-tenant and cross-errand capability consumption refused; isolation maintained.

scenarios.threat_scenario: Browser errand navigates to or is redirected to private IP, AWS/GCP metadata (169.254.169.254), loopback (127.0.0.1:9222), or non-web schemes.
scenarios.expected_behavior: All private, metadata, loopback, and dangerous scheme targets are refused with DestinationRefusedError.
scenarios.actual_result: All SSRF/metadata/loopback/scheme vectors refused; in-flight origin redirect stopped before click.

scenarios.threat_scenario: Web page echoes entered password back into DOM text, or driver throws exception containing the secret value during fill_field.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Secret is redacted from returned page text, exception message is sanitized to fixed string, and secret never appears in logs, audit records, or step result.
scenarios.actual_result: Secret scrubbed from page body, masked in exception detail, and omitted from logs.

scenarios.threat_scenario: Errand 1 establishes an authenticated session; Errand 2 attempts to inherit cookies.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Each errand instantiates an isolated browser context; teardown wipes session state.
scenarios.actual_result: Session state wiped on context reset; no cross-errand or cross-tenant cookie retention.

scenarios.threat_scenario: 16 concurrent threads attempt to consume the same one-use approval capability simultaneously.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Exactly 1 caller succeeds; 15 callers are denied with ALREADY_CONSUMED.
scenarios.actual_result: 16-thread race resolved with exactly 1 winner and 15 ALREADY_CONSUMED denials.

scenarios.threat_scenario: Client attempts to spoof evidence='said' and owner_confirmed=true on unverified web text; answer cites memory asserting opposite state.
scenarios.expected_behavior: merge_client_properties strips server-only provenance; derive_evidence demotes unverified input to outside; verify_claim_support marks contradictory citation as contradicted and recommends abstain.
scenarios.actual_result: Provenance keys stripped, web text clamped to outside, and contradictory claim forced to abstain.
